name: Dhan (DhanHQ MCP)

login.how: signed in through /mcp (plugin:ai-trader:dhan → Authenticate). Check with portfolio_agent_tool action funds; if it says unauthorized or the session expired, ask the user to Authenticate again in /mcp (or call the server's login tool and show its link)

sl_order_args: trading_agent_tool action place: transactionType SELL, exchangeSegment NSE_EQ, securityId, quantity, orderType STOP_LOSS, productType CNC, triggerPrice = stop, price = stop x 0.98 (tick-rounded down), validity DAY
protection_how: a Dhan conditional trigger (alerts_agent_tool): price at or below the stop places a SELL CNC MARKET order; stays active until its expDate. Confirmed working by the plugin's author.
